title: TCP: Update RST diagnostic payload for draft-15
description: Update the RST diagnostic payload dissector from draft-14 (done in !23616) to [draft-boucadair-tcpm-rst-diagnostic-payload-15](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-boucadair-tcpm-rst-diagnostic-payload/). The wire format changes in draft-15 to split the single format into two: a compact format and a free-description format.
